evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Myxoid degeneration of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus without tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: undersurface tear of the body/posterior horn junction.
evidence.Medial OA: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the weightbearing medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau.
evidence.Lateral OA: Small area of full-thickness cartilage loss along the weightbearing lateral tibial plateau with subchondral edema with low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the weightbearing lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau.
evidence.PF OA: Multifocal areas of full-thickness cartilage loss along the medial facet, median ridge, lateral facet, and lateral femoral trochlea
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
